question: An object is thrown upwards. At the highest point of its trajectory, its:

options.text: both kinetic and potential energy are zero
both kinetic and potential energy are maximum

solution:
The correct answer is __**3**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• At the highest point of its trajectory, the **velocity of the object in the vertical direction becomes zero**. This implies that the object has no kinetic energy in the vertical direction.
 
• The object still has **potential energy due to its height** above the ground, and this potential energy is maximum at the highest point.
